full_judgment: 4. The trial Court dismissed the suit on the findings that although plaintiff has successfully proved his right, title and interest in the land in suit but he has failed to prove his possession in the land in suit and as such the suit so framed is not maintainable since he was required to seek declaration of title to the property in suit and also for khas possession, that the suit is also barred by limitation and the suit is bad for non-joinder of party since Administrator of Waqfs was required to be implead as party in the suit.
